claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md returns Q with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied P with success at least 0.39 under the heuristics of proof.md section 9, and all classical work is bounded by 2^120.763093468 dense-Fp12 units (ledger: proof.md section 8). Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes pool, region, yield, cost, ledger, linear algebra, descent and every declared bound (quick, ~10 s); quick=false adds [6], [6b], [11], [11b], [12] (~16 s); extra='relw' runs the live relation-weighted unit-duplicate and sampler checks, extra='sensitivity' the estimate-0/1 SE descent rows (each < 20 s).
